sentences.en: The teacher gave me a good critique on my project.
sentences.zh: 老师对我项目的批评很中肯。

sentences.en: My only critique for my car was its acceleration.
sentences.zh: 我对我的车唯一的批评就是它的加速性能。

sentences.en: Critique of Pure Reason is German philosopher Immanuel Kant's chief literary work.
sentences.zh: 《纯粹理性批判》是德国哲学家伊曼努尔·康德的主要著作。
